text:
Manufacturing contains concentrations of machine tools, electric and heavy equipment industries employing about 35% of the total employment in Milwaukee County.
The wholesale-retail trade is the second largest employer in Milwaukee County, using about 21% of the total employment.

Professional and related services are the next largest employer with 18%.
!!ilwaukee County's ranking economic importance nationwide is listed as follows:
3rd largest Metropolitan exporter of machinery
6th largest in volume of industrial production
7th largest Metropolitan user of steel
9th largest county in value added by manufacture
10th largest exporting county in the nation
12th in median household income among 30 largest Metropolitan areas
13th largest exporter of 30 largest Metropolitan areas
19th largest populated Metropolitan area
According to the latest traffic statistics prepared by the Airport Operators Council International, General Mitchell Field ranks in the low 30's according to total passengers (enplaned + deplaned) and the mid twenties in air cargo tonnage. As a medium air traffic hub it is ranked as the 70th busiest airport in total aircraft operations. The disparity in total passenger and air cargo rankings is due to the proximity of O'Hare International Airport which takes 20-25% of the area's passenger demand.
